name: ihav-openrouter-pareto
description: OpenRouter models as quality or weekly usage vs list price, one Pareto chart per output modality, from public catalog data and the models Table.

interface.shortDescription: OpenRouter quality or usage vs price, with Pareto frontiers
interface.longDescription: Fetch OpenRouter's public model catalog and typed per-image prices without a key, read the models Table in a browser when one is available, and build one offline HTML page with a tab per output modality (text, image, speech): a chart of a chosen metric against one price component and unit, the Pareto step line, hover details and a table, plus CSV and JSON. Weekly tokens measure usage, not quality. Prices are list prices; units are never converted.
defaultPrompt: Which OpenRouter text models give the best intelligence for their input price?
Build the OpenRouter Pareto charts for text, image and speech.
What changed on OpenRouter between my last two captures?
